question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin own BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is feasible and narrowly located, but it changes retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent FTS indexing, and fallback policy for an official memory plugin.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, query-text propagation, hybrid retrieval, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and direct advanced hybrid/rerank behavior to an external package or ClawHub plugin path.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the feature direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core or QMD owns hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, query-text propagation, hybrid retrieval, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.
